cards.name: Espeon
cards.description: It uses the fine hair that covers its body to sense air currents and predict its enemy's actions.

cards.name: Scizor
cards.description: It swings its eye patterned pincers up to scare its foes. This makes it look like it has three heads.

cards.name: Smeargle
cards.description: A special fluid oozes from the tip of its tail. It paints the fluid everywhere to mark its territory.

cards.name: Tyranitar
cards.description: Its body can't be harmed by any sort of attack, so it is very eager to make challenges against enemies.

cards.name: Umbreon
cards.description: When darkness falls, the rings on the body begin to glow, striking fear in the hearts of anyone nearby.

cards.name: Unown [A]

cards.name: Ursaring
cards.description: Although it is a good climber, it prefers to snap trees with its forelegs and eat fallen berries.

cards.name: Wobbuffet
cards.description: To keep its pitch-black tail hidden, it lives quietly in the darkness. It is never first to attack.

cards.name: Yanma
cards.description: If it flaps its wings really fast, it can generate shock waves that will shatter windows in the area.

cards.name: Beedrill
cards.description: It can take down any opponent with its powerful poison stingers. It sometimes attacks in swarms.

cards.name: Butterfree
cards.description: It collects honey every day. It rubs honey onto the hairs on its legs to carry it back to its nest.

cards.name: Forretress
cards.description: Its entire body is shielded by a steel-hard shell. What lurks inside the armor is a total mystery.
